hints.title: Submatrix Increment Boundary Marking
hints.text: Instead of modifying all cells in each rectangle, mark only the 4 boundary corners in a 2D difference array.

hints.title: 2D Difference Corners
hints.text: For query (r1, c1, r2, c2), add 1 at (r1, c1), subtract 1 at (r1, c2 + 1) and (r2 + 1, c1), and add 1 at (r2 + 1, c2 + 1).

hints.title: 2D Cumulative Integration
hints.text: Compute 2D running cumulative sums row by row and column by column to reconstruct final cell values.

hints.title: 2D Difference Array Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def rangeAddQueries(self, n: int, queries: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        diff = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
        for r1, c1, r2, c2 in queries:
            diff[r1][c1] += 1
            diff[r1][c2 + 1] -= 1
            diff[r2 + 1][c1] -= 1
            diff[r2 + 1][c2 + 1] += 1
        mat = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
        for r in range(n):
            for c in range(n):
                top = mat[r - 1][c] if r > 0 else 0
                left = mat[r][c - 1] if c > 0 else 0
                top_left = mat[r - 1][c - 1] if r > 0 and c > 0 else 0
                mat[r][c] = diff[r][c] + top + left - top_left
        return mat
```

complexity.notes: Each query updates 4 corners in O(1) followed by single 2D prefix sum pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Updating every cell per query takes O(Q * n^2) which reaches 10^8 operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies standard 2D difference array and prefix sum reconstruction.
